title: Declare a read-only calculation
intro: PreviewTotal returns a small result without adding a business change.
context: Inside the entity body of the existing custom ZI_Order BDEF with alias Order. Create the abstract result entity ZA_OrderPreview first, with Amount of type abap.dec(15,2) and CurrencyCode of type abap.cuky. The projection requires use function PreviewTotal; if this function is exposed through the service.

highlights.label: Choose a function
highlights.explanation: This declares an instance function: the caller selects existing orders. The implementation must only read and calculate.

highlights.label: Return one preview per successful input
highlights.explanation: The result has Amount and CurrencyCode. The [1] cardinality describes the declared result; a missing or rejected order still needs a failure response.

outcome: The behavior contract now names the operation and its result. The generated handler still needs an implementation.
caveat: A BDEF fragment, not a complete BO. Verify the result entity, authorization, projection, service binding and function support on the target release. A function is not automatically rendered as an action button.

title: Return 30 without changing the order
intro: Read Quantity 3 and UnitPrice 10 from the current transaction, then return their product.
context: Handler method for function PreviewTotal result [1] ZA_OrderPreview in custom BO ZI_Order, alias Order. ADT generates METHODS PreviewTotal FOR READ IMPORTING keys FOR FUNCTION Order~PreviewTotal RESULT result. Quantity and UnitPrice are decimal fields, CurrencyCode is CUKY, and ZA_OrderPreview contains Amount DEC(15,2) and CurrencyCode CUKY. The public function authorization is configured separately.
code:
METHOD PreviewTotal.
  READ ENTITIES OF zi_order IN LOCAL MODE
    ENTITY Order
    FIELDS ( Quantity UnitPrice CurrencyCode )
    WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
    RESULT DATA(lt_orders)
    FAILED DATA(ls_failed)
    REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).
  failed = CORRESPONDING #( DEEP ls_failed ).
  reported = CORRESPONDING #( DEEP ls_reported ).
  result = VALUE #( FOR ls_order IN lt_orders
    ( %tky = ls_order-%tky
      %param-Amount = ls_order-Quantity * ls_order-UnitPrice
      %param-CurrencyCode = ls_order-CurrencyCode ) ).
ENDMETHOD.

highlights.label: Read the pending values
highlights.explanation: EML reads this BO transaction, including unsaved changes. Local mode is used inside its own implementation, not as an external authorization bypass.

highlights.label: Keep failed inputs visible
highlights.explanation: Forward the read failures and messages. A key that produced no row must not silently be presented as a successful preview.

highlights.label: Return a calculation, not an update
highlights.explanation: %tky links each result to its order. Amount becomes 30 for Quantity 3 and UnitPrice 10. No MODIFY, INSERT or COMMIT occurs.

outcome: The caller receives Amount 30 with its currency. The order buffer and database remain unchanged.
caveat: Teaching handler body with stated custom types, not an activated application. Production amounts need agreed decimal ranges and currency rounding. Test multiple keys, denied execution and missing instances. A read-only implementation must not trigger remote business changes.

title: Connect a default function to an action
intro: The action receives DiscountPercent; its default function proposes the initial value.
context: Inside the Order entity body of custom BDEF ZI_Order. ZA_Discount is an existing abstract parameter entity with DiscountPercent of type abap.int1. Expose both use action ApplyDiscount; and use function GetDefaultsForApplyDiscount; in the consuming projection.

highlights.label: Declare the real input
highlights.explanation: ApplyDiscount will receive the percentage the caller actually submits. The action must validate that value.

highlights.label: Attach the input suggestion
highlights.explanation: The default function is associated with this action. RAP derives its parameters and result; the GetDefaultsFor name is a framework convention.

outcome: A supporting consumer can request suggested values before it executes ApplyDiscount.
caveat: This declares the link, not the action logic or UI button. Generate the required methods in ADT and verify backend, binding and Fiori elements support. A direct caller can skip defaulting.

references.title: SAP sample: default function projection exposure

title: Suggest 10 or 5 percent without applying it
intro: The suggestion depends on the selected order, so a function is more useful here than one fixed default.
context: Body of the ADT-generated handler for GetDefaultsForApplyDiscount in custom ZI_Order, alias Order. The instance action uses ZA_Discount with DiscountPercent INT1. The generated method is FOR READ IMPORTING keys FOR FUNCTION Order~GetDefaultsForApplyDiscount RESULT result. All teaching orders use EUR and Total is decimal; 1000 EUR is an illustrative threshold, not a SAP pricing rule.
code:
METHOD GetDefaultsForApplyDiscount.
  CONSTANTS co_large_order TYPE decfloat34 VALUE 1000.
  CONSTANTS co_large_discount TYPE i VALUE 10.
  CONSTANTS co_small_discount TYPE i VALUE 5.
  READ ENTITIES OF zi_order IN LOCAL MODE
    ENTITY Order
    FIELDS ( Total ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
    RESULT DATA(lt_orders)
    FAILED DATA(ls_failed)
    REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).
  failed = CORRESPONDING #( DEEP ls_failed ).
  reported = CORRESPONDING #( DEEP ls_reported ).
  result = VALUE #( FOR ls_order IN lt_orders
    ( %tky = ls_order-%tky
      %param-DiscountPercent = COND #(
        WHEN ls_order-Total >= co_large_order
        THEN co_large_discount ELSE co_small_discount ) ) ).
ENDMETHOD.

highlights.label: Read the inputs for the suggestion
highlights.explanation: Use each selected order's current total. Orders of 1200 EUR and 200 EUR qualify for different suggestions.

highlights.label: Forward read failures
highlights.explanation: Keep missing or failed instances identifiable instead of returning a made-up percentage for every input key.

highlights.label: Fill the dialog values only
highlights.explanation: %param contains 10 for the large order and 5 for the small one. No discount is applied until the actual action executes and validates its own input.

outcome: The consumer receives one suggestion per successfully read order. Cancelling the dialog changes no business data.
caveat: An illustrative rule, not a complete pricing implementation. Handle currencies, rounding and policy changes in a real app. The action must recheck permission and input; default values can be edited, skipped or become outdated. Verify multi-selection behavior in the actual client.
